# `aitbc edge gpu get-gpu`

Get details of a specific edge GPU.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge gpu get-gpu [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | The Gpu id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge gpu get-gpu --gpu-id <gpu_id>
```
